newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KAUNO AUDINIAI APRIL SALES DROP.
newsitem.headline: KAUNO AUDINIAI APRIL SALES DROP.

text.p: Kauno Audiniai textiles company said on Thursday that its sales in April were 1.72 million litas compared with 2.2 million litas in Aril 1996.
But chief accountant Angele Trumpiene declined to give profit figures for April.

The company's first quarter profit was 186,000 litas, a sharp drop from 906,000 litas in the same period of 1996. Sales in the first quarter of 1997 were 6.12 million litas versus 7.84 million litas in the first three months of 1996.
"We are planning a net profit of 1.50 million litas in 1997," Trumpiene added.

The profit and the sales of the company went down due an unfavourable exchange rate as the main client of the company is the German firm Sohl&Sohlke, which buys around 70 percent of the output, Trumpiene said.
A further 20 percent of the production is bought by Italian Miroglio Tessile.
Another reason for the profit fall was a rise in energy prices and in some raw material costs, she added.
The company posted a 1.02 million litas net profit in 1996.
The company's share capital is 21.4 million litas and the sales last year were 28.9 million litas.
Hansa Investments has around an 11 percent stake in the company and it is listed in the A group of the bourse.
